knowledge_point.title: Multiplying a 2x2 Matrix by a Column Vector

question.:question/worked-solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product. Multiplying the first row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 \\ -10 & -3\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}8 \\ 7\end{bmatrix} & =\begin{bmatrix}1\cdot 8+2\cdot 7 \\ ∗\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}22 \\ ∗\end{bmatrix}.\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying the second row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 \\ -10 & -3\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}8 \\ 7\end{bmatrix} & =\begin{bmatrix}22 \\ (-10)\cdot 8+(-3)\cdot 7\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}22 \\ -101\end{bmatrix}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 
$Hn=\begin{bmatrix}22 \\ -101\end{bmatrix}.$

If $P=\begin{bmatrix}-2m & -2n & 2m \\ -2m & 2n & 2m \\ 0 & -2 & 0\end{bmatrix}$ and $u=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ p \\ 1\end{bmatrix},$ find $Pu.$
$Pu=$
{{field-1}}
{{field-2}}
{{field-3}}
question.:question/worked-solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}Pu & =\begin{bmatrix}-2m & -2n & 2m \\ -2m & 2n & 2m \\ 0 & -2 & 0\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ p \\ 1\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}(-2m)\cdot 1+(-2n)\cdot p+2m\cdot 1 \\ (-2m)\cdot 1+2n\cdot p+2m\cdot 1 \\ 0\cdot 1+(-2)\cdot p+0\cdot 1\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}-2m-2np+2m \\ -2m+2np+2m \\ 0-2p+0\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}-2np \\ 2np \\ -2p\end{bmatrix}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Find $By$ if $B=\begin{bmatrix}4p & -4q \\ -p & 3q\end{bmatrix}$ and $y=\begin{bmatrix}p \\ q\end{bmatrix}.$
$By=$
{{field-1}}
{{field-2}}
question.:question/worked-solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}By & =\begin{bmatrix}4p & -4q \\ -p & 3q\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}p \\ q\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}4p\cdot p+(-4q)\cdot q \\ (-p)\cdot p+3q\cdot q\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}4p^{2}-4q^{2} \\ -p^{2}+3q^{2}\end{bmatrix}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Find $Tu$ if 
$T=\begin{bmatrix}x & y & x \\ x & -y & x \\ -x & -y & x\end{bmatrix}$
and
$u=\begin{bmatrix}x \\ 0 \\ -x\end{bmatrix}.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}Tu & =\begin{bmatrix}x & y & x \\ x & -y & x \\ -x & -y & x\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}x \\ 0 \\ -x\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}x\cdot x+y\cdot 0+x\cdot (-x) \\ x\cdot x+(-y)\cdot 0+x\cdot (-x) \\ (-x)\cdot x+(-y)\cdot 0+x\cdot (-x)\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}x^{2}+0-x^{2} \\ x^{2}+0-x^{2} \\ -x^{2}+0-x^{2}\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 0 \\ -2x^{2}\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Find $By$  if 
$B=\begin{bmatrix}b & b \\ c & c\end{bmatrix}$
and
$y=\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 4\end{bmatrix}.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product: 

$$
\begin{aligned}By & =\begin{bmatrix}b & b \\ c & c\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 4\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}b\cdot 3+b\cdot 4 \\ c\cdot 3+c\cdot 4\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}3b+4b \\ 3c+4c\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}7b \\ 7c\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$
